k-sym-SWJ.title: Stand With Jensen petition coins
k-sym-SWJ.sourceSays: Posts say Nvidia employees petitioned for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO, that Elon Musk said he is signing a petition, and that standwithjensen.com is one of the petitions circulating.
k-sym-SWJ.reason: Posts of Nov 13 report an Nvidia employee petition and Musk signing a petition; SWJ pools opened hours later (0.4-2.2h old). Claims are unverified; other posts flag the coin's buyers as suspect.
